name: @shopify/dev-mcp
description: A command line tool for setting up Shopify Dev MCP server

scripts.promptfoo:test: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c artifact.yaml
scripts.promptfoo:all: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c promptfoo/configs/e2e_tests.yaml
scripts.promptfoo:featureflags: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c promptfoo/configs/e2e_tests.yaml --filter-pattern 'FeatureFlag:|WebComponents:.*ABLED'
scripts.promptfoo:main: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c promptfoo/configs/e2e_tests.yaml --filter-pattern 'Admin:|Partner:|Customer:|Storefront|Payments|Polaris|POSUI|Liquid:|Functions:'
scripts.promptfoo:build: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c promptfoo/configs/e2e_tests.yaml --filter-pattern 'BUILD:'
scripts.promptfoo:functions: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c promptfoo/functions.yaml --max-concurrency 10
scripts.promptfoo:custom-data: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c promptfoo/custom-data.yaml
scripts.promptfoo:ts: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c promptfoo/configs/e2e_tests.yaml --filter-pattern 'Polaris|POSUI|Hydrogen|WebComponents'
scripts.promptfoo:hydrogen: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c promptfoo/hydrogen.yaml
scripts.promptfoo:pos: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c promptfoo/pos_ui.yaml
scripts.promptfoo:app-home: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c promptfoo/app_home.yaml
scripts.promptfoo:storefront-web-components: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c promptfoo/storefront-web-components.yaml
scripts.promptfoo:admin-extensions: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c promptfoo/admin-extensions.yaml
scripts.promptfoo:checkout-extensions: npm run build && promptfoo eval -c promptfoo/checkout_extensions.yaml
